newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: Zambia's three-month T-bill rate dips.
newsitem.headline: Zambia's three-month T-bill rate dips.

text.p: Zambia's central bank sold three-month Treasury bills at an average discount rate of 24.7071 percent at its latest auction, it announced on Monday.
The bank said it sold 27.0 billion kwacha of the 91-day bills at last Thursday's auction. The rate was slighlty down from the previous week's 25.0758 percent.
It also sold 8.0 billion kwacha of 28-day Treasury bills at an average discount of 19.3002 percent, down from the previous week's 22.2773 percnet.
Five billion kwacha of 182-day bills were sold at an average 22.0211 percent against 24.1517.
